basic_info.description:
Welcome to 155 Bridgeview Drive, an elegantly updated home situated in the Silver Terrace neighborhood of San Francisco, known for its easy commute. This residence features 3 spacious bedrooms and 3 pristine bathrooms, all meticulously renovated to blend modern convenience with classic charm. The entire house has been thoughtfully updated with new plumbing, a new furnace, new electrical systems in bathrooms and kitchen, and new lightings throughout, ensuring worry-free living.

The inviting living room, centered around a cozy fireplace, offers a warm ambiance conducive to relaxation and entertaining. A bonus studio-like area downstairs, with its separate entry, provides flexible living optionsideal for multi-generational families, hosting guests, or creating a comfortable work-from-home space.

With 1,235+ square feet of living space set on a convenient 1,132-square-foot lot, this home offers both comfort and versatility. Experience refined urban living at its finest.
